text.description_html:
First Impressions PR-DLG100SMTSS4, Delong Stainless Steel Back to Back Pull Set

This Delong Stainless Steel Back to Back Pull Set comes packaged with everything you need to install it on a door made of wood, fiberglass, glass, or metal including 2 pulls (one for the exterior and one for the interior) and lock-down rosettes (not pictured). This modern door pull is available in 12 inch, 24 inch, 36 inch, and 18 inch lengths. The grip is made out of stainless steel and the hourglass-shaped mounts are made out of brass, allowing the possibility to mix and match finishes. Fancy a door pull with black brackets and a contemporary brushed stainless steel handle? This is the pull for you. The Back-to-Back Stainless Steel Delong Pull is made in the USA by First Impressions--a leader in custom door hardware.

Packaged with Back to Back mounting (2 door pulls bolted to each other - 1 door pull for each side of a door). Includes lock down threaded rosettes to securely tighten the door pulls to the door.

Also available as an Individual Door Pull.

Specifications for the First Impressions Delong Door Pull Pair:

  • Pull Handle Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • First Impressions PR-DLG100SMTSS4 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available in 4 Sizes:

    PR-DLG100012SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 12"
    • Center to Center Mount: 8"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 7/8"
    • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
    • Pull Clearance: 1.66"

    PR-DLG100024SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 24"
    • Center to Center Mount: 18"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 7/8"
    • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
    • Pull Clearance: 1.66"

    PR-DLG100036SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 36"
    • Center to Center Mount: 24"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 7/8"
    • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
    • Pull Clearance: 1.66"

    PR-DLG100048SMTSS4:
    • Total Length: 48"
    • Center to Center Mount: 36"
    • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
    • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 7/8"
    • Total Projection: 2-3/4"
    • Pull Clearance: 1.66"

Note: This First Impressions door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including different center to center mounting distances and Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Cancelable or Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
